titles.native: フニクリ フニクラ（登山電車）

description:
The Japanese version of the 1880 Neapolitan song Funiculì funiculà, originally composed by Luigi Denza, with lyrics from Peppino Turco. A Japanese rendition of the song performed by Japanese vocal group Duke Aces was originally broadcast on NHK's Minna no Uta program in April 1961. It was released under the title Tozandensha (Mountain Railway) and was accompanied by shadow play from the Kakashiza Shadow Play Theatre. It is believed to now be lost media.

In June 1970, a performance of the song by the Osaka Sumiyoshi Boys and Girls Choir (Osaka Sumiyoshi Shounen Shoujo Gasshoudan) was broadcast on the Minna no Uta program, this time using the original song title.
